messages:
Priya - CS: quick heads up — Acme Health sent a vendor risk pack and a proposed DPA amendment. They want: SOC2 evidence, subprocessors list, and confirmation on data retention. Deadline is their EOD Fri. Can we pull together what we can share?

Liam (Security): we can provide the SOC2 Type II report (redacted) and a subprocessors list. we don't publish full ROPA. ask them whether a control mapping is required or a summary will do. :thinking_face:

Alex - Legal: send their proposed DPA amendment here. if retention/erasure language changes, we'll need to confirm with product. otherwise we can sign an addendum with standard liability clauses.

Priya - CS: pasted the vendor's DPA snippet they highlighted:
```
7. Data Retention. Customer may request deletion of Personal Data. Vendor shall delete or return Personal Data within 60 days unless otherwise required by law.
```
They also asked for subprocessors and if we use any overseas processors.

Jordan - Eng: we use AWS (us-west-2) and S3/GCS for backups. subprocessors: Datadog (monitoring), Sentry (errors), Segment (analytics). encrypt at rest with AES-256. sample config snippet for encryption at rest: ```json
{"s3_encryption": "AES256", "kms_key_alias": "alias/redwood-prod"}
```

Sam - CS: looping @Alex - Legal and @Liam for final artifacts. I'll draft an email to Acme with the package once we have signed DPA.

Liam (Security): I'll assemble: SOC2 cert (redacted PDF), subprocessors CSV, short encryption statement, and a one-page control summary. aiming for tomorrow afternoon. :thumbsup:

Alex - Legal: I'll review the DPA amendment now. if the 60-day deletion is a hard change we may push back to 90 days or add exception for backups. will post redlines by EOD tomorrow.

Priya - CS: perfect. target to return to Acme by Thu EOD to give them room. Sam — can you set a reminder?

Onboarding Bot: Reminder created: "Acme DPA package follow-up" — Thu 09:00. (I'll ping this thread then.)

Sam - CS: thanks — I'll start drafting the cover email and attach placeholders. will update thread with links to artifacts once ready. :white_check_mark:

Liam (Security): one more note — remove any user identifiers from the SOC2 before sharing. i'll sanitize and drop into the shared drive and post link here.

Priya - CS: thanks everyone. will monitor for any vendor follow-ups and escalate if they ask for a full control mapping.

Alex - Legal: noted. if they request full ROPA we'll require an NDA or a redacted export.

Jordan - Eng: posted subprocessors CSV to drive: https://drive.internal/redwood/acme-subprocessors (internal only).

Priya - CS: closing loop for now. next steps: Liam to upload artifacts, Alex to finalize redline, Sam to send draft email. target Thu EOD to vendor. :rocket:
